jobs.occupation: International Clinician Scientist (f/d/m) for iPRACTIS (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
Die Medizinische Hochschule Hannover (MHH), mit rund 10.000 Beschäftigten größter Landesbetrieb des Landes Niedersachsen, ist eine universitäre Einrichtung für Forschung und Lehre in der Human- und Zahnmedizin und ein Universitätsklinikum der Supramaximalversorgung. Forschung, Lehre, Krankenversorgung und Administration arbeiten im Integrationsmodell auf dem MHH-Campus Hand in Hand.
About us

Hannover Medical School (MHH) is offering positions in the international clinician scientist program (iPRACTIS), a unique opportunity for internationally mobile researchers with a completed medical degree outside of Germany. Over three years, you will gain experience in translational research while working towards medical degree recognition in Germany.

iPRACTIS supports internationally trained researchers aiming to build careers in academic medicine. Over three years, participants will deepen their research experience on a translational research project while working towards integration into the German academic and healthcare system.

We offer

The international clinician scientist program iPRACTIS offers:

- 36 months of structured clinical and scientific training based on an individually tailored career plan
- Individualized support in navigating the process of medical degree recognition in Germany and developing German language proficiency
- Funding for materials, travel, and publication
- Individualized support from a personalized mentoring team
- A curriculum to acquire key competencies [including data management and analysis, GCP clinical investigator certification (GCP-Prüfarztkurs), project management]
- Regular evaluations and feedback meetings
- A full onboarding program and integration into a strong Clinician Scientist Network

Clinical expectations: Participants will achieve recognition of their medical qualifications along with sufficient German language skills for clinical practice, allowing future specialist training and medical practice in Germany.

Research expectations: Participants will develop as a R2 researcher (according to the European Framework for Research Careers), including submitting their first third-party funding application. Participants who complete this process will be ready to pursue an independent research career (R3) in roles such as assistant professor, principal investigator, or junior group leader.

Eligibility requirements

To apply, candidates must:

- Hold a completed medical degree (from outside Germany)
- Have initial research experience (completed R1 to early R2 based on European Framework for Research Careers)
- Have not yet completed specialist clinical training (residency or German 'Facharzt' / 'Weiterbildung' equivalent)
- Be committed to pursuing a career combining clinical practice and research

In order to consider your application, we require that you submit the completed "iPRACTIS Application Template" (download) as well as a cover letter and detailed resume (in table format), a declaration of consent and copies of certificates (medical examination certificates, doctoral degree certificates, high school diplomas, and other relevant certificates and documents. If the documents are not in German or English, a certified translation is requested). Please submit your application as a single PDF file directly to practis@mh-hannover.de. More information can be found at iPRACTIS.

External applications for iPRACTIS positions will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The deadline for internal applications is 05.01.2027.
For questions, please reach out to Dr. Thorsten Saenger: practis@mh-hannover.de.

jobs.occupation: Wissenschaftliche Mitarbeiterin als Gruppenleitung für MIN (w/m/d) (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
For our location in Hamburg we are seeking:

Postdoctoral researcher for X‑ray microscopy at atomic resolution

Limited: 2 years | Starting date: earliest possible | ID: FSPO009/2026 | Deadline: 20.10.2026 |

Full-time/Part-time

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The Advanced Multilayer X‑ray Optics group at CFEL is one of the leading research groups developing novel X‑ray lenses, also known as multilayer Laue lenses (MLLs). We plan to further improve and extend MLLs as part of a large project to image, understand and ultimately control electron dynamics in molecular systems. To do this, we are combining concepts from X-ray microscopy, crystallography, and ultrafast X‑ray science. Here is an opportunity for a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to be part of our team and this exciting project.

About your role:

- Prepare and conduct scientific experiments at various X‑ray facilities (synchrotrons and XFELs)
- Develop and apply techniques to characterize and improve X‑ray lenses (MLLs) and gratings
- Extend and improve X‑ray imaging modalities towards atomic resolution
- Explore the feasibility of MLLs for various experiments and for their increased use at lab, synchrotron and XFEL sources
- Communicate findings via publications and presentations

About you:

- PhD in physics, applied physics or a related field
- Sound knowledge of Fourier optics, X-ray physics, and metrology
- Experience in experimental methods or development of instrumentation
- Experience with synchrotron and XFEL experiments is an advantage
- Good programming skills, especially in Python
- Proficient in English and in writing scientific articles
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
- High self-motivation and ability to work in an interdisciplinary team

Good reasons to join:

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Gender equality is an important aspect for us. To support work life balance we offer flexible working hours and variable part-time. You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV‑AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.

For further information please contact Dr. Saša Bajt at +49 40 8998‑2082 (https://tel:+494089982082) , sasa.bajt@desy.de (sasa.bajt@desy.de)

Please submit your complete application documents (letter of motivation and research interests, CV, list of publications, relevant certificates and three letters of references). For our Hamburg location, we are looking for a

Global GtM Transformation Manager (m/f/d)

to join us at the earliest possible date.

The role

The Global Out-of-Home (OOH) Excellence team is responsible for developing world-class capabilities that enable sustainable growth, operational excellence, and superior customer experiences across all markets. By defining strategic standards, future-fit operating models, technology roadmaps, and governance frameworks, the team drives consistency, scalability, and innovation across the global OOH network. 

The GTM Transformation Manager (d/w/m) is responsible for defining the strategic direction and transformation roadmap for Go-to-Market capabilities across the global Ice Cream business. This role owns the vision, governance, capability development agenda, and continuous improvement strategy for critical GTM processes including distributor management, retail execution, route optimization, order management, delivery planning, warehouse operations, and supporting technologies. 

A key aspect of this role is working directly with markets to understand operational realities and identify improvement opportunities through operational assessments, audits, and capability reviews. 

What you'll be responsible for

Define the long-term GTM capability vision, roadmap, and transformation priorities. 

Own governance and global standards for distributor management, retail execution, route optimization, order collection, delivery planning, and warehouse management. 

Lead large-scale GTM transformation programs across markets. 

Provide strategic oversight of GTM technologies including DMS, retail execution, warehouse and analytics platforms. 

Lead end-to-end market assessments and operational excellence reviews. 

Observe day-to-day operations in markets to identify capability gaps and improvement opportunities. 

Facilitate operational audits, workshops and diagnostic sessions with market teams, consultants etc.

Develop actionable improvement roadmaps and monitor delivery of agreed actions. 

Influence senior stakeholders and align strategic investments and priorities. 

Manage strategic relationships with vendors and external partners. 

We're looking for someone who

Brings significant experience in FMCG, sales operations, customer operations, supply chain, GTM excellence or related fields.

Has a strong track record of leading transformation programs and driving capability development at scale.

Demonstrates deep expertise in route-to-market strategies, distributor management, retail execution and operational excellence.

Has experience conducting operational reviews, diagnostics, audits and capability assessments.

Combines strategic thinking with strong analytical and commercial acumen.

Is comfortable working with technology-enabled solutions and has strong digital and systems understanding.

Influences and collaborates effectively with senior stakeholders across functions, markets and cultures.

Thrives in complex, global environments and can balance strategic priorities with hands-on execution.

Is willing to travel internationally on a regular basis (approximately 30%+ of working time) to support market reviews, workshops and transformation initiatives.

Typically brings 8–12 years of relevant professional experience.

Business-fluent English skills are required; proficiency in additional foreign languages is considered an advantage.

What you'll get

Alongside meaningful work and strong development, we offer a reward package that typically includes:

About us NET CHECK GmbH was founded in 1999 with the aim of improving the quality of communication networks. Since then, NET CHECK has developed into the leading partner of network operators and infrastructure providers of mobile and fixed networks of all technologies. Its core competencies include international network benchmarking (comparative measurements) as well as network planning and fault analysis. NET CHECK has one of Germany's largest crowdsourcing platforms, which generates over 144 million data points every day. Our commitment to quality and security has earned us the trust of scientific and government institutions.
NET CHECK is headquartered in Berlin and is part of the NC GROUP, an owner-managed group of companies with a total of over 180 employees at five locations in Germany and one in Belgrade, Serbia.

Job Summary: We are seeking a Senior Microelectronics Engineer for Embedded Systems to join our hardware R&D team. The successful candidate will play a key role in the design, development and validation of electronics and embedded solutions for telecommunication measurement systems. This position involves leading the design of microelectronic circuits, developing embedded firmware and ensuring the integration across hardware and software components.
Responsibilities
• Design and develop microelectronic circuits for telecom measurement equipment.
• Develop and optimize embedded firmware for STM32 microcontrollers using C/C++, with expertise in UART, Ethernet, and USB communication interfaces.
• Perform schematic design, prototyping and laboratory testing to ensure product reliability and compliance with telecom industry standards.
• Lead design reviews and drive design improvements across hardware and firmware domains.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (hardware, software and mechanical) to integrate hardware designs into system architecture.
• Research and evaluate latest microelectronics and embedded technologies relevant to telecom measurement systems.
• Prepare comprehensive technical documentation, including design specifications, verification procedures and detailed engineering reports.
• Provide technical guidance to junior engineers while contributing to continuous improvement initiative within the hardware R&D team.

Your profile
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in microelectronics and embedded system design.
• Proven expertise in embedded firmware development using C/C++ on STM32 or similar ARM-based microcontrollers.
• Hands-on experience with communication interfaces such as UART, Ethernet and USB.
• Solid knowledge in circuit design, PCB layout design and hardware debugging.
• Proficiency with electronic design in CAD tools (e.g. KiCAD, Eagle).
• Familiarity with RF systems, telecom interfaces (e.g., LTE, 5G, Wi-Fi), and signal processing is a strong plus.
• Experience in laboratory testing, prototyping and performance optimization of embedded systems.
• Excellent communication skills in English (written and spoken), German is a plus.

• Employment Type: Full-Time, indefinite term.
• A dynamic team characterized by creativity, collaboration, and technical excellence, creating an innovative workplace.
